And certainly not making life more affordable for American families.

This illegal scheme threatens to trap borrowers, students, and families in chaos—while taxpayers foot the bill. I’m fighting to stop it.

Trump is threatening mass death in Iran if he doesn’t get his way. He has spiraled out of control—and Congress has the power to stop him and end this war.

Every Republican lawmaker who refuses to speak out, ducks a question, or votes to continue this war bears responsibility.

Trump is threatening war crimes to annihilate "a whole civilization".

Republicans in Congress repeatedly voted for Trump’s war and still won't do their job to end this madness.

Enough. Bring Congress back into session.

Republicans must grow a spine and stop this catastrophe.

How will he pay for it? By gutting health care, housing, climate, and education programs, and making life harder for families.

None of this puts America first.
